request.spec:
A retired person can be unretired (a button on the row; PERSON_UNRETIRED name=<name> on=<the
sheet's today>; anyone not retired is refused with an error on the row). They are no longer retired
(retired no, no retired-from); the retirement is kept on the row as <from> to <the day unretired>, one line per past
retirement; and a claim dated after the from and before the to of a
past retirement is refused as a claim after a retirement is.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Unretiring now works, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec. Getting there also needed a fix to an unrelated as-of bug, explained below.

**What's in place**
- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V71__person_past_retirement.sql`, adds a `person_retirement` table with one row per past retirement (from-date, to-date).
- **Server:**
  - New endpoint `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/people/{personId}/unretire`, built the same way as the retire endpoint.
  - It refuses anyone who isn't retired with an error. Otherwise it saves the retirement as a past one ending on the sheet's today and clears `retiredFrom`.
  - It writes `PERSON_UNRETIRED sheet=… by=… name=… on=…`, followed by the usual ROLLUP/TOTALS lines.
- **Claim refusal:** the existing check that refuses claims after a retirement now also refuses a date strictly after a past retirement's from and before its to. Because it's the shared check, it applies to adding, quick-add, paste, re-dating and reassigning a claim. The error message names the past retirement's range.
- **Person data:** `Person` and `PersonResponse` carry `pastRetirements`, oldest first. Merging or dropping a person deletes their past retirements; transferring moves them to the new sheet with the person.
- **Front end:** the Retired column on each row has an Unretire button (`person-unretire`). Each past retirement appears as a `person-retirement-line` reading "<from> to <to>". A refusal shows in `person-error`.

**The unrelated fix:** "unretire scenario 2" failed on the pool total share when the sheet was viewed as of an earlier date. That part of the test never touches retirement. The cause is that viewing the sheet as of a date copies only tables that have a `sheet_id` column, and `pool_member` has none. The pools request then came back as an empty 200 response with no error in the log, and the screen kept showing pools as of the real today. I changed `AsOfSchemas.java` so the earlier-date copies also include `pool_member` rows that belong to the sheet's pools. That changes as-of pool reads generally, not just in this test.

I created a temporary debug spec in `e2e/specs/` to find the bug and deleted it afterwards; the test, `bin/*` and `e2e/support/` are unchanged.
